question: Find the French foreign names of all cards illustrated by John Avon that have a black border color, do not have multiple faces (side IS NULL), and belong to sets released after January 1, 2010. Among these, only include cards that are either non-foil-only or have no powerful foil identifiers (i.e., lack both cardKingdomId and cardKingdomFoilId).

prediction.sql:
SELECT fd."XCL_079"
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c."XCL_072" = fd."XCL_082"
WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'John Avon'
  AND c."XCL_005" = 'black'
  AND c."XCL_012" IS NULL
  AND s."XCL_112" > '2010-01-01'
  AND fd."XCL_077" = 'French'
  AND (c."XCL_004" != 'foil' OR (c."XCL_007" IS NULL AND c."XCL_006" IS NULL))
